channel.title: Your Engine changelog
channel.description: Every ship of Your Engine by OddsEngine, dated. $ODDS on Robinhood Chain: 0x9c87b4cfa21266d1638f437c96dbe1012cb81111

item.title: Nomad AI checks with OddsEngine before it signs
item.description: Nomad AI, the agent Nomad runs on its own platform, scans a token with scan_token and checks the transaction with check_before_sign before it signs. It runs on Robinhood Chain. Its activity is public at thenomad.website/ai.

item.title: A plain message when a model is down
item.description: When an AI model provider has an outage, Your Engine now answers with one plain line instead of the raw error from the provider.

item.title: OddsEngine inside Nomad
item.description: Agents set up with Nomad can run OddsEngine's safety checks over MCP: scan_token before a buy and check_before_sign before a signature. Nomad carries the OddsEngine server from app to app and never copies the key. Each user connects an own key. Results end with "Checked by OddsEngine."

item.title: Check a payment before your agent sends it
item.description: check_before_sign now checks payments too. Pass the recipient, and if you want your approved payees and your limit per payment. DO NOT SIGN when the recipient is not on your list, the amount is over the limit, the address is a look-alike of an approved payee, or it is in our records for draining wallets or was funded by one. CAREFUL when the recipient is brand new or has no history. The address checks run without a list too. Each safety check costs $0.02. The developer docs have the fields and an example.

item.title: Own icons instead of emojis
item.description: The cards in the docs, the chat suggestions and the scan reports now use our own line icons. They look the same on every device.

item.title: Auto mode is live for the first account
item.description: Auto mode places the engine's Above X calls on your own Kalshi account, inside the limits you set per call and per day. Live for the first account. More seats open step by step. Your money stays on your own account. The engine never holds it.

item.title: Proof of Call
item.description: Ask Your Engine "check @name" and it measures every call that X account made in the last 90 days: every coin they promoted, by contract or clear $ticker, with the market cap at the post, the peak after and today, and every bullish or bearish post on BTC, ETH and SOL, right or wrong after 24 hours and 7 days. Links to every post and a chart image.

item.title: Tax export covers TRON and TON
item.description: The tax export now reads your TRON and TON wallets too: TRX, TON, tokens and swaps with the value at the time, gain or loss per sale and the holding period. TRON and TON wallets in your portfolio are added automatically. Eight chains in one Excel file.

item.title: TRON and TON
item.description: Scan any coin on TRON and TON: market, contract flags, holders and the deep scan with first buyers, bundles, snipers, fresh wallets and wallet groups. Add your TRON and TON wallets to the portfolio. No trading on these two chains yet.

item.title: Above X is in the app
item.description: The live Above X record now sits on the Engine screen and in the Crypto tab: result, start to now, green days and the result per day. You see it without connecting a wallet. Auto mode is shown to everyone. Invite only.

item.title: Your Engine says what it does, right at the top
item.description: The first screen of Your Engine now says what the product is and what it does for you: scans coins, guards your wallet, tracks your portfolio, Auto mode. Thanks to the community for the feedback.

item.title: Auto mode shows what is missing
item.description: The Auto mode card now opens with three steps: hold 1% of the supply, load your $ODDS balance, connect your Kalshi key. Each open step says exactly what is missing and has its own button: Buy $ODDS or Top up now. Change your daily limit and the balance you need updates right away.

item.title: New front page
item.description: oddsengine.live now opens with the Above X results: total, calls settled, green days and the day by day chart, live from the engine. New Auto mode section: the five steps, what a seat needs and what it costs. The roadmap cards are gone. The page only lists what is switched on today.

item.title: Elysium scans
item.description: Scans now cover Elysium, the Kinetiq chain: dev wallet, who funded it, holders, price and market cap, straight from the chain. Wallets in a scan are matched against wallets the engine already knows from other chains. Deposits bridged in from HyperEVM are recognised as the same owner, not as a new wallet.

item.title: Coin links across chains
item.description: Ask the engine to compare several coins. It now checks all EVM chains together for shared devs, funders and early buyers. New link type: a wallet that funded the dev of another coin.

item.title: Meta Rotation finds its own runners
item.description: The engine now looks for strong runners by itself and adds their earliest wallets to what it watches. Only wallets with an entry the chart confirms are kept.

item.title: Burn page counts tokens sent to the contract
item.description: $ODDS sent to the token contract address cannot be moved again. The burn page now counts them and lists each transfer.

item.title: Fix: Verify $ODDS on weather calls
item.description: The Verify $ODDS button on the weather calls of the public app showed no message on some tabs. Fixed.

item.title: Auto mode, closed testing
item.description: Above X calls on BTC and ETH can now be bought automatically in a holder's own Kalshi account, within limits the holder sets. The Kalshi key is stored encrypted and never shown again. The engine never holds funds. A seat needs 1% of the $ODDS supply in the wallet. Drop below and Auto mode pauses at once. Fee: 20% of profit, taken from the $ODDS balance. No profit, no fee. Closed testing with the first holders.

item.title: Holder map by KYLL in Robinhood Chain scans
item.description: Every Robinhood Chain scan now has a button that opens the BalloonMap by KYLL for that coin: every wallet a balloon, linked wallets in one color. It opens on their site, with their wording.

item.title: Scan fix: liquidity held by hook contracts
item.description: Some coins on Robinhood Chain keep their liquidity inside Uniswap V4 hook contracts (for example Doppler) instead of a locker. Scans now say who holds it, instead of showing 0% locked. We name the contract and leave the lock question to its code, so the scan never claims a lock it cannot read.

item.title: v2.81: Launch Board: every Torch launch with the facts
item.description: Every new coin on Torch gets a full scan within minutes of launch: dev share and sales, launch block buys, bundled supply, top 10, holders, liquidity and dev history. Live at engine.oddsengine.live/launches. Each card links to the proof on the explorer and opens the full scan in Your Engine. Facts only. No rating, no badge, no advice.

item.title: v2.81: Scans show facts, not verdicts
item.description: Token scans in Telegram, on the web report, in X replies and in the x402 API no longer say clean, risky or high risk. Each scan lists what the chain shows, so you decide.

item.title: v2.80: What HEY read: builder records in every Robinhood Chain scan
item.description: Token scans and Project Research on Robinhood Chain now show what HEY Research Lab recorded about the team: verified builder or not, recent ships and status, with a link to the full record on HEY. It is shown as HEY's record, next to our own findings and never mixed with them.

item.title: v2.80: Scan fixes: first buyers and launcher contracts
item.description: Holdings of the first buyers are read straight from the token, so large coins no longer show 0% still holding by mistake. Coins made through a factory or launcher contract show both: the dev wallet and the launcher it used.

item.title: v2.80: Locker page: extra safety checks
item.description: The page only talks to the one ODDS Locker contract it was built for. If the server ever named another contract, every button locks and a warning shows. NFT positions (for example Uniswap V3 LP) are blocked before you approve anything: they could not be withdrawn again. Locking for another wallet needs a second confirmation, with a clear warning for contracts and exchange deposit addresses. Independent review of the contract: only the lock owner can withdraw, nothing unlocks early, and the admin can only change fees and the treasury.

item.title: v2.80: Database pool: deep scans fast again
item.description: The engine used one database connection for everything; under load up to 990 threads waited in one queue. Rebuilt with a connection pool, now 10 to 40 threads. Deep scans that could not start are no longer stuck as running for 10 minutes.

item.title: v2.80: x402: pay per scan with USDC on Base or Solana
item.description: Any AI agent can buy a full token scan per call, no key and no signup: GET api.oddsengine.live/v1/x402/scan, $0.02. Pays with USDC on Base, USDC on Solana (fees paid by the facilitator) or $ODDS on Robinhood Chain. Discovery data in every 402 answer and a list of paid endpoints at /v1/x402/resources. Live tested: our own agent paid on Base, tx 0x27da4e08cf97053220c556a3a261c5994d4b31c6272db4647e75eac6a5634c68. Live tested on Solana: our agent paid in USDC, tx KzMUrsFzRvm9MVW8FQLcGue8jPHxDSqv142G7iQbFEZZv58QHVfMqsC1u3yp3CuymVKHuHwxuxL5m9JadxzcDBg.

item.title: v2.78: Funder network in the deep scan
item.description: Who funded the dev, what that wallet did with the coin, which other wallets it funded, whether they launched coins through the same launch contract, ETH sent back, admin wallets with the same funder. With proof links. Launch block buys counted by amount bought, not by what is held now: a 10% snipe sold within seconds no longer passes as no bundle. The money trail always follows the first funding payment, also small gas money.

item.title: v2.78: Dev check, Wallet Guard and voice
item.description: Dev check reads where the dev's tokens came from: own allocation, bought or received, and retries when the RPC is busy. Wallet Guard: an approval given inside your own buy is a quiet note, not an alarm. Approvals outside your own trades still alert. Voice recognition knows the coins that were scanned recently.

item.title: v2.77: Scan fixes on Robinhood Chain
item.description: Liquidity held by a launchpad (Torch, Pons) is shown as such instead of 0% locked. Locks are shown even when small. LP pools ranked by liquidity. Copycat warnings only for the same chain. Smart wallets counted only with a strong record.

item.title: v2.77: Portfolio card
item.description: Portfolio across all your wallets as one card: total, by coin with PnL against your buy, by wallet. Holdings without a price are named instead of silently left out.

item.title: v2.74: Radar track record
item.description: Every coin the GTA radar finds is followed for 3 days (1 h, 6 h, 24 h, 72 h, peak) and marked runner, dead or flat.

item.title: v2.73: Portfolio manager
item.description: Add your own wallets in the chat and track them across chains.

item.title: v2.72: Robinhood stock tokens, 24/7
item.description: Prices around the clock, daily movers, comparison with the exchange price and alerts in percent.
